caption: The drawing depicts a carousel horse in mid-gallop, facing to the right. The horse is predominantly white, with areas showing signs of wear and chipped paint revealing underlying layers. There are remnants of yellow and red painted details on the horse’s body, especially along the saddle area and near the center. The mane and tail are sculpted with flowing lines and also colored white with light shading. The horse is fitted with a black saddle and black bridle, both of which are drawn with realistic texture and shading. Under the saddle, traces of purple paint can be seen. There is a single metal stirrup hanging down on the visible side of the horse. The background is plain and beige, which provides contrast to the detailed depiction of the horse itself.
title: Carousel Horse
